ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a transition-state skeleton structure, and the arrows indicate electron movement but the question requires them to be ignored. The central carbon is connected to an R2 substituent, an acetoxy fragment O-C(=O)CH3 connected through oxygen, and a positively charged nitrogen atom. This nitrogen atom is marked with a positive charge and is connected to R1, R, and an acetyl group C(=O)CH3. The figure also separately draws a negatively charged acetate/acetoxy anion OAc. Reasoning: As required, replace R, R1, and R2 all with the wildcard *. From the central carbon, write *C(...), its oxygen substituent is OC(C)=O, and the cationic nitrogen substituent is [N+](*)(*)C(C)=O. The separate acetate is another component, separated by a dot, written as CC(=O)[O-]. Merging gives SMILES: *C(OC(C)=O)[N+](*)(*)C(C)=O.CC(=O)[O-].

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: Read the skeletal structure from the image, ignoring all arrows and using only atom connectivity and charges. Replace each R/R1/R2 substituent with '*'. Start from the central carbon wildcard substituent as '*C(...)...', attach the acetoxy group as OC(C)=O, attach the cationic nitrogen as [N+](*)(*)C(C)=O, then append the separately drawn acetate anion after a dot as CC(=O)[O-]. Combine these pieces into the SMILES expression *C(OC(C)=O)[N+](*)(*)C(C)=O.CC(=O)[O-].
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个过渡态骨架结构，箭头表示电子移动但题目要求忽略。中心碳连接一个 R2 取代基、一个通过氧连接的乙酰氧基片段 O-C(=O)CH3，以及一个带正电的氮原子。该氮原子标有正电荷，并连接 R1、R，以及一个乙酰基 C(=O)CH3。图中还单独画出一个带负电的乙酸根/乙酰氧负离子 OAc。推理：按要求将 R、R1、R2 都替换为通配符 *。从中心碳写作 *C(...)，其氧取代基为 OC(C)=O，阳离子氮取代基为 [N+](*)(*)C(C)=O。单独的乙酸根作为另一个组分，用点号分隔，写作 CC(=O)[O-]。合并得到 SMILES：*C(OC(C)=O)[N+](*)(*)C(C)=O.CC(=O)[O-]。

planner_metadata.image_role: Inspect the image while ignoring curved arrows: identify a transition-state/ionic structure with a central carbon bearing R2, an acetoxy substituent O-C(=O)CH3, and a positively charged nitrogen; the nitrogen is bonded to two generic R groups and to an acetyl group C(=O)CH3. Also identify a separate acetate anion labeled OAc with negative charge.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the requested output is the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and that arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: represent unspecified R groups as wildcard atoms '*'; encode positively charged tetravalent nitrogen as [N+]; encode acetate anion as CC(=O)[O-]; separate disconnected ionic components with a dot; write acetoxy as OC(C)=O and acetyl on nitrogen as C(C)=O / C(=O)C connectivity.
